# Canonical required status checks for the `main` branch of thuram-nana/vigil-sovereign.
#
# THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Three things key on it, and must never disagree:
#   1. tools/governance/require-checks.sh  — reads this file to set live branch protection (--apply).
#   2. docs/tests/test_required_checks_canonical.py — an OFFLINE required test that asserts every name
#      here is produced by a real pull_request-triggered job, that no nightly-only job is listed, and
#      that every doc stating a required-check count/list agrees with this file.
#   3. .github/workflows/branch-protection-verify.yml — reads live protection from the GitHub API and
#      fails if it drifts from this list.
#
# RULES:
#   - One check context per line. Blank lines and lines beginning with `#` are ignored.
#   - A name here MUST equal a job `name:` in .github/workflows/*.yml that runs on `pull_request`.
#     A required check that no PR job produces blocks EVERY pull request forever (the exact trap
#     tools/governance/require-checks.sh is arranged around). The offline test refuses that.
#   - The nightly-only `livefire full table (nightly)` is deliberately NOT here: it never reports on a
#     PR, so requiring it would block every PR. The offline test asserts it stays out.
#   - Every OTHER pull_request job that is deliberately NOT required (the advisory security scans, the
#     pre-commit mirror, the perf-regression gate, the wider W2-2 lint sweep, the daily supply-chain
#     scan, and the token-gated branch-protection live-pin) is enumerated WITH A STATED REASON in the
#     KNOWN_ADVISORY ledger of docs/tests/test_required_checks_canonical.py. That offline test asserts
#     the pull_request job set equals EXACTLY (this file plus that ledger), so a NEW pull_request job
#     cannot become silently unguarded the way five jobs once did (W0-2 #397).
#   - Order is not significant; every consumer compares as a set. This file is kept in the GitHub API's
#     case-insensitive order purely so a human can diff it against the live settings by eye.
#
# Live protection also sets: strict = true (branch must be up to date), enforce_admins = false
# (the owner keeps an attributable admin override), allow_force_pushes = false, allow_deletions = false.
# Required reviews and required signed commits are NOT enabled — a deliberate, scheduled handoff, not a
# shipped control. Do not add a line here for a control that is not actually enforced.

A14 supply-chain gate
CRUCIBLE core on vigil_core
CRUCIBLE eval + benchmark corpus
formal (TLA+ core-invariant model check, F1)
gateway egress gate (P6)
integration two-env boundary (P5)
livefire smoke (per-PR subset)
loopback engagement (end-to-end + offline re-verify)

the briefing explains every agent and capability
